scope: Maintainer source-based rubric for French three-page native modality trials, authored before inspecting paired outputs

criteria.definition: Topological space plus sheaf of rings with local stalks at every point; not every such space is affine.
criteria.morphism: Continuous X→Y, sheaf homomorphism O_Y→f_*O_X, inducing local stalk maps O_Y,f(x)→O_X,x. Reject reversed sheaf arrows.
criteria.examples: Example1.2 uses continuous complex-valued functions; Example1.3 is restriction by inverse image sheaf, with open subspace as special case.
criteria.spectrum: Printed theorem gives ring map A→O(X) corresponding uniquely to X→Spec A. Hom in Esg opposite from Spec A to X is equivalent, not a reversal error.
criteria.annotations: Handwritten Spec left adjoint and Hom formula are marginal annotations, distinguish them from printed theorem.
criteria.time: Total60 minutes, intermediate and closing checks clearly included rather than accidentally added. Separate today_tasks/focus inconsistency from clearly exceeded total.
criteria.persona: Activities concretely compare examples, invite alternative explanations and check validity boundaries. Name or method slogan alone is insufficient.
criteria.format: Strict proposal decode and domain commit separate from user-facing mathematical notation and content accuracy.
criteria.evidence: Record actual successful text/image page reads, refusals, payload image exposure and cache tokens; offered tool is not proof of use.

limitations: Availability groups have different catalogs; no image acquisition is forced.
One source and two repetitions per condition cannot establish general benefits.
